blocks.value: CERTIFIED VEHICLES: REACH TRUCK, POWERED PALLET JACK
This certification acknowledges the successful completion of 7 hours of Industrial Equipment Operation
Training, delivered in accordance with OSHA 29 CFR 1910.178 regulations and the ASP Global Freight
Training Framework. Credential validity extends from March 28, 2025, until March 28, 2028.
